text:
## Template 1: Account Opening Confirmation  
**Subject:** Your FirstUK Bank Account Is Ready! 🎉  
```
Dear [Customer Name],

Your SmartSaver account with FirstUK Bank is now open and ready to use.

Account Details:
- Account Number: [ACC-XXXXX]
- Sort Code: 20-00-00
- Current Balance: £[amount]

What's Next:
1. Log in at www.firstuk.bank/login
2. Set up Two-Factor Authentication for security
3. Make your first deposit (transfer, branch, or standing order)
4. Download our mobile app for easy access

Your Current Rate:
Based on your balance, you're earning 4.50% AER on your SmartSaver.
Your first interest payment will arrive at the end of this month.

Questions?
- Phone: 0800-555-2265
- Email: support@firstuk.bank
- Website: www.firstuk.bank/faq

Welcome to FirstUK Bank! We're delighted to have you.

Best regards,
FirstUK Bank Customer Service
```
